description: Defines the FormattedText class for representing and manipulating formatted text within the MigraDoc document object model, including methods for adding various text elements, formatting options, and serialization.

classes.name: FormattedText
classes.description: Represents formatted text with methods to add various text elements, formatting options, and serialization support.

classes.name: FormattedText.FormattedTextValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for FormattedText, including font, style, and paragraph elements.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the FormattedText object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying of the object, including cloning font and elements.

methods.name: AddBookmark
methods.description: Adds a bookmark with specified name and position.

methods.name: AddChar
methods.description: Adds a character or repeated characters to the formatted text.

methods.name: AddNumPagesField
methods.description: Adds a total number of pages field.

methods.name: AddInfoField
methods.description: Adds an info field of specified type.

methods.name: AddFootnote
methods.description: Adds a footnote with optional text.

methods.name: AddHyperlink
methods.description: Adds a hyperlink of various types.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image from a file.
